left.title: Famously Litigious Trump Advised Theresa May to Sue EU Over Brexit
left.body: President Donald Trump seems to have spent much of his first official visit to the UK mansplaining to the country’s prime minister, Theresa May.
left.roundup: British Prime Minister Theresa May said that President Trump advised her to sue the European Union over Brexit, revealing the secret suggestion that she had previously said was "too brutal."

center.title: Theresa May Says Trump Advised Her to Sue the EU
center.body: U.K. Prime Minister Theresa May on Sunday revealed the secret advice she received from President Donald Trump on how to handle Brexit talks: He suggested the U.K. sue the European Union.
center.roundup: British Prime Minister Theresa May said that President Trump advised her to sue the European Union over Brexit, revealing the secret suggestion that she had previously said was "too brutal."

right.title: May Says Trump Told Her to SUE the EU, President Says It’s Still Not Too Late to Get ‘Brutal’ with Brussels
right.body: Prime Minister Theresa May has revealed that President Donald Trump’s “brutal” advice on dealing with the EU was that she should sue the bloc instead of making concessions to it.
right.roundup: British Prime Minister Theresa May said that President Trump advised her to sue the European Union over Brexit, revealing the secret suggestion that she had previously said was "too brutal."
